literal_meaning: জলের হাওয়া (water's air or watery breeze)
example_sentences_in_english: The weather here is very pleasant.
The weather becomes unbearable in summer.
history: An archaic Bengali term from older literature and dialects, referring to atmospheric conditions, possibly evoking humid or riverine climates typical in Bengal.
note: This is more of an archaic synonym than a true idiomatic expression with figurative depth.
